english.title: Permit use of a pedal cycle without lights at night
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a pedal cycle in motion at a time between sunrise and sunset when the

(A)_[front position lamp]_
(B)_[rear position lamp]_
(C)_[front and rear position lamps]_

required to by fitted by the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989

(D)_[was]_
(E)_[were]_

not kept lit and unobscured
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 24(1)(a) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989 and section 91 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
